section.p: A different way to remember the digits

div.p: Four digits become a glyph. A glyph becomes a familiar movement. Little by little, you connect them into something you can recall.
Tap the dial, or drag and pause on each digit. Take another look when you need it. Your place is saved when you leave.
No countdown. Just the next four.
Small steps. Longer connections.
Learn a group. Recall it. Then join it to the one before. Stillvaro brings difficult connections back into practice, helping you build longer passages at your own pace.

article.h3: Pick up where you left off.
article.p: Your place and unfinished input save automatically. A small session can fit into an ordinary day.
Practice works offline. No account, advertising, tracking, or third-party analytics SDKs. Learning records stay on your device.
VoiceOver, larger text, light and dark appearances, haptics, and support for your motion and contrast preferences.

div.p: A few things to know

details.summary: Do I need to know any digits of π?
details.p: No. Start with 3141, including π’s leading 3 and leaving out the decimal point. Guide shows you where to begin, one four-digit group at a time.

A connected practice experience with Guide, Memory, and Watch; exploration from different places in π; the Memory Spiral; untimed memory tests; Learning trends with recall charts and group-level heatmaps; and a native iPad workspace with adaptive layouts and a choice of dial position. Read about version 2.0.

details.summary: Does it work without an internet connection?
details.p: Yes. Practice, learning schedules, progress, and tests work on your iPhone or iPad. Opening the App Store, website, or email support uses external services.

Progress saves locally on each device, with a previous valid save kept for recovery. There is no automatic sync between devices or progress import/export. Device backups may include app data depending on your settings. Read about saving and backups.

details.summary: Are there subscriptions or in-app purchases?
details.p: No. The current release has no subscriptions or in-app purchases. The App Store shows the current download price for your region.
Stillvaro 2.0 is designed for iPhone and iPad. It requires iOS 26 or iPadOS 26 or later. On iPad, the app follows system rotation and adapts its layout to your window.
